name: whisper-base-sk
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-base (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-05. Full-parameter Slovak fine-tune of openai/whisper-base by the KInIT team, trained on a curated Slovak corpus with on-the-fly noise augmentation on 75% of batches. Same tensor set and same config.json as the base (6 encoder + 6 decoder layers, d_model 512, vocab 51,865); 72.59M safetensors params against the base's 74M. A finetune, not a new base model, and not a merged adapter. Recorded because it publishes base-vs-finetune rows from one run on the same eval sets. CAVEAT the card states itself: this is a single-language model and catastrophic forgetting is explicit - it warns to use the base for multilingual work, so the WER win is Slovak-only. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-08-20. The card also prints a six-size sweep table (Whisper Base 14.01% vs 76.38%) confirming the same numbers.
